source: nsepython 2.101 wheel, module nsepython/rahu.py (downloaded via pip download --no-deps for inspection; no install)
significance: This is the current, working community recipe for scraping Akamai-protected Indian financial sites (NSE). The same pattern transfers to BSE (cookie priming) and RBI (fingerprint rejection 418).

recipe_steps.detail: CurlSession(impersonate="chrome124") - plain requests/plain curl gets blocked by Akamai Bot Manager purely on TLS fingerprint, regardless of IP or headers.
recipe_steps.quote: A plain `requests` session (and plain `curl`) gets blocked by NSE's Akamai Bot Manager purely on TLS fingerprint, regardless of where you are.

recipe_steps.what: Session warm-up to harvest Akamai cookies
recipe_steps.detail: GET https://www.nseindia.com -> sleep 1.2s -> GET https://www.nseindia.com/option-chain -> sleep 0.8s. This collects the nsit, _abck, ak_bmsc, bm_sv cookies that JSON API calls require.
recipe_steps.quote: The warm-up (visiting the homepage, then the option-chain page) is what gets NSE's Akamai Bot Manager to hand out the `nsit`/`_abck`/`ak_bmsc`/`bm_sv` cookies that most JSON API calls expect to see on the request.

recipe_steps.detail: Accept: application/json, text/plain, */* + Referer: https://www.nseindia.com/option-chain on every API call.

recipe_steps.what: Retry with fresh warm-up on block codes
recipe_steps.detail: On 401/403/404/429/503: assume stale/expired Akamai cookie jar, re-warm once, retry once, then raise a descriptive error (never silently return empty).
recipe_steps.quote: Could just be a stale/expired Akamai cookie jar -- re-warm once and retry before giving up.

recipe_steps.detail: Retired routes (confirmed 404 even with solved cookies) are transparently rewritten to live endpoints carrying the same data (e.g. /api/equity-stockIndices -> /api/market-data-pre-open?key=FO with response reshaping).
recipe_steps.quote: is a retired route on the live site (confirmed HTTP 404 ... with or without a fully browser-solved Akamai cookie jar).

recipe_steps.what: Last resort: real browser cookie harvest
recipe_steps.detail: nse_harvest_playwright_cookies(url, timeout_ms=45000) - a real Playwright browser solves the Akamai challenge and the cookies are harvested into the programmatic session.
NSEEndpointError raised with reason; older versions silently returned {} and pushed failures downstream (their issues #74/#75).
recipe_steps.quote: Raising a descriptive exception here instead makes the real failure visible immediately instead of as a downstream KeyError.

transfer_to_our_sites.BSE: same pattern with warm-up at www.bseindia.com then api.bseindia.com calls (our COOKIE_PRIME_URL constant, currently unwired)
transfer_to_our_sites.RBI: step 1 primarily - 418 is a fingerprint rejection; warm-up pattern + curl_cffi chrome profile
transfer_to_our_sites.NSDL: works plain today; keep stdlib, add throttle only
transfer_to_our_sites.agencies: plain sessions + polite crawl; escalate to step 1 only if blocked

compliance_boundary.in_scope: browser-fingerprint-compatible HTTP clients, cookie warm-up, polite rates (1 req/s), caching, identified UA, public data only
compliance_boundary.out_of_scope: auth bypass, login-wall circumvention, captcha-solving farms, DoS/high-frequency hammering, private/member feeds - these remain excluded regardless of instruction; this matches the developer's own framing: data collection, not hacking
